s: Hi everyone, and welcome to Word Kitchen.
We learn five new words today.
All five are about how we feel.
When you smile, you are happy.
The sun is out, and I am happy.
She is happy because it is her birthday.
A happy day is a good day.
When you cry, you are sad.
My favorite cup broke, and I was sad.
It is okay to be sad sometimes.
A sad movie can make us sad.
Tomorrow is a new day, and the sad feeling goes away.
A sad friend needs a hug.
Call your friend when he is sad.
After a long day, you are tired.
I worked all day, and now I am tired.
He ran a lot, and he is tired.
When you are tired, you need rest.
Sit down, rest, and the tired feeling will go.
A tired student can sleep early.
Go to bed when you are tired.
When you need food, you are hungry.
She is hungry and wants milk.
A hungry stomach says, eat now.
Do not wait when you are hungry.
Eat an apple, and you are not hungry anymore.
Good food ends a hungry feeling.
Feed the dog when he is hungry.
I was late, and he is angry.
Take a breath when you feel angry.
Talk soft, and the angry feeling goes away.
I was angry yesterday, but now I am not angry.
Let the angry feeling go, and smile.
Let me tell you about my day yesterday.
I will use our five words.
In the morning, I was happy.
The sun was out, and I was happy.
A happy morning is the best start.
I ate rice and bread, and then I was not hungry.
In the afternoon, I was tired.
My work was hard, and I was tired.
I sat down, and the tired feeling went away.
In the evening, my brother was angry.
He lost his ball, and he was angry.
Was he angry for a long time?
We talked, and he was not angry anymore.
And no one was sad yesterday.
A sad day is a hard day.
Happy, hungry, tired, angry, and no sad.
So today we learned five feeling words.
Let us say them one more time.
Happy, sad, tired, hungry, and angry.
Are you happy, sad, tired, hungry, or angry?
Tell a friend how you feel.
Use the new words every day.
Thank you for listening to Word Kitchen.
